stitch_shortlist.author: @clemfom
stitch_shortlist.claim: A pimple patch works on ANY wound to draw moisture out

pitch.the_claim: That a hydrocolloid pimple patch can go on any wound and ‘draws the moisture out.’
pitch.why_it_stitches: 13M views and 3.6K comments on a claim that’s backwards — hydrocolloid keeps a wound MOIST to heal, it doesn’t pull moisture out; and ‘any wound’ needs caveats.
pitch.your_fit: You already film pimple patches (‘derms get pimples too’) AND you own the danger line: ‘a pimple that won’t heal in 6–8 weeks could be skin cancer.’ Perfect bridge.
angles: ‘You want me to WHAT?’: it’s hydrocolloid — it heals by keeping moist, not by drawing out
Empathy-first: patches are great on a whitehead — here’s where they’re useless (or risky)
The red flag: don’t patch a spot that won’t heal — get it checked
